24.0.en: Each seam was [[refine:refined]] again, and the tubes were [[simplify:simplified]] for easy daily care.
24.0.zh: 每道接缝都重新修整过，管路也做了简化，日常打理更容易。

24.1.en: Grey water would be [[purify:purified]], and soup bits [[filter:filtered]] for the garden beds.
24.1.zh: 灰水会被净化，汤渣也会被滤出来用于菜床。

24.2.en: Drinking water was not [[distil:distilled]]; that [[mode:mode]] needed more heat and time.
24.2.zh: 饮用水没有蒸馏，那种方式需要更多热量和时间。

24.3.en: The third [[prototype:prototype]] stood on a light [[wooden:wooden]] [[framework:framework]] near the gate.
24.3.zh: 第三个原型立在大门旁轻巧的木架上。

24.4.en: Each new [[aspect:aspect]] looked fine, yet one [[phase:phase]] still leaked at [[night:night]].
24.4.zh: 每个新方面都看着不错，可有一个环节夜里还是会漏。

24.5.en: Old Chen taught the students to [[operate:operate]] the spouts and [[facilitate:facilitate]] fast morning checks.
24.5.zh: 老陈教学生们操作水嘴，让清晨检查又快又顺。

25.0.en: They could [[transform:transform]] [[ditch:ditch]] water and [[convert:convert]] it for the flower beds.
25.0.zh: 他们能转化沟里的水，再改造出来浇灌花坛。

25.1.en: They did not [[alter:alter]] the roof path, but did [[shift:shift]] the jars to gather rain.
25.1.zh: 他们没改动屋顶水道，只是挪动罐子来收集雨水。

25.2.en: At [[dusk:dusk]] the [[crew:crew]] would [[turn:turn]] the valves and [[adapt:adapt]] the flows for [[thirsty:thirsty]] roots.
25.2.zh: 黄昏时分，全组人转动阀门，为干渴的根调整水流。

25.3.en: They would [[adjust:adjust]] the small screws and [[pinpoint:pinpoint]] drips with chalk marks.
25.3.zh: 他们拧动小螺丝，用粉笔记号精准定位漏水点。

25.4.en: The readings grew [[accurate:accurate]] and [[precise:precise]] after three calm [[trial:trial]] days.
25.4.zh: 经过三天平稳的试验，读数变得又准又精。

25.5.en: Each [[correct:correct]] fitting saved water, and every fixed [[error:error]] taught them care.
25.5.zh: 每个正确的接件都省下水，每处改正的错误都教人细心。

26.0.en: One small [[mistake:mistake]] revealed a thin [[flaw:flaw]] in the lower left seam.
26.0.zh: 一个小失误暴露了左下接缝处细细的裂痕。

26.1.en: [[welcome home:Welcome home]] signs cheered the workers, hiding each small [[fault:fault]] with smiles.
26.1.zh: “欢迎回家”的牌子鼓舞着工人，笑容掩过一个个小故障。

26.2.en: A loose stone made Li [[stumble:stumble]], a dull [[contingency:contingency]] they soon fixed.
26.2.zh: 一块松动的石头绊了李一跤，这桩小意外很快就被处理好了。

26.3.en: In hard [[circumstance:circumstances]] the old sea man stayed a true [[pioneer:pioneer]] for everyone.
26.3.zh: 在艰难的处境中，老海员依然是大家真正的先驱。

26.4.en: No loud [[prophet:prophet]] promised wins, yet a kind [[herald:herald]] praised their [[steady:steady]] work.
26.4.zh: 没有高声的预言者许诺胜利，和善的报信人却夸他们的活儿做得稳。

26.5.en: The old man named Mei his [[heir:heir]] for the jars, and Lan his [[successor:successor]] for the notes.
26.5.zh: 老人指定梅做罐子的继承人，兰做记录的接班人。

27.0.en: Three school [[generation:generations]] joined, writing a shared [[surname:surname]] [[list:list]] on [[paper:paper]].
27.0.zh: 三代学生一起加入，在纸上写下同姓的共用名单。

27.1.en: No one asked [[gender:gender]] questions; every [[pupil:pupil]] and [[spouse:spouse]] helper got the same tasks.
27.1.zh: 没人问性别，每个小学生和配偶帮手都领同样的任务。

27.2.en: The kind old [[grandfather:grandfather]] and his tired [[father-in-law:father-in-law]] carried the heavy jars.
27.2.zh: 和善的老祖父和疲惫的岳父搬起沉重的大罐。

27.3.en: Each [[sibling:sibling]] brought a [[cousin:cousin]] to scrub bottles after lunch every day.
27.3.zh: 每个兄弟姐妹都带个表亲，每天午饭后刷瓶子。

27.4.en: Little [[nephew:nephew]] Tao poured slowly, while [[niece:niece]] Ana held the funnel high.
27.4.zh: 小侄子涛慢慢倾倒，侄女安娜把漏斗高高举着。

27.5.en: They watched the bean [[embryo:embryos]] wake, just like a weak [[infant:infant]] opening its eyes.
27.5.zh: 他们看着豆胚苏醒，就像虚弱的婴儿慢慢睁开眼睛。

28.0.en: A stray dog, a small [[orphan:orphan]], followed every [[juvenile:juvenile]] helper to the [[shed:shed]].
28.0.zh: 一只流浪小狗，小小的孤儿，跟着每个少年帮手走进棚屋。

28.1.en: Each [[youngster:youngster]] shared bread, and [[youth:youth]] songs kept the long noon bright.
28.1.zh: 每个年轻人分着面包，青春的歌声把漫长的正午唱得明亮。

28.2.en: No noisy [[gang:gang]] blocked the path; [[teenage:teenage]] volunteers swept the [[lane:lane]] daily.
28.2.zh: 没有喧闹的帮派挡路，青少年志愿者每天清扫小巷。

28.3.en: In bright [[adolescence:adolescence]] they learned much, helped by close [[kin:kin]] nearby.
28.3.zh: 在明媚的青春期里他们学到很多，身边有亲近的亲戚帮忙。

28.4.en: Country [[folk:folk]] stopped to watch, and one far [[relative:relative]] sent seeds by post.
28.4.zh: 乡亲们驻足观看，一位远方的亲戚还寄来了种子。

28.5.en: Close, [[intimate:intimate]] chats grew nightly, with [[dear:dear]] thanks for rice and tea.
28.5.zh: 亲密的夜谈渐渐多起来，为米饭和茶献上真挚的感谢。

29.0.en: Little Ying, a [[darling:darling]] of all, served cold tea to every plant [[lover:lover]].
29.0.zh: 人见人爱的小莹，给每位爱花的人端上凉茶。

29.1.en: Their [[beloved:beloved]] teacher [[madam:Madam]] Lin praised the neat joints and calm hands.
29.1.zh: 孩子们敬爱的林老师夸接头整齐、双手沉稳。

29.2.en: The smiling [[hostess:hostess]] poured tea, while the [[stern:stern]] [[landlady:landlady]] washed the cups.
29.2.zh: 笑盈盈的女主人倒茶，板着脸的女房东洗杯子。

29.3.en: The kind [[mistress:mistress]] of the yard and a busy [[housewife:housewife]] mopped the floor.
29.3.zh: 院子那位和善的女主人和忙碌的家庭主妇一起拖地。

29.4.en: Old [[widow:widow]] Su sewed cloth bags, and a quick [[maid:maid]] rinsed the jars.
29.4.zh: 苏寡妇缝着布袋，手脚麻利的女仆冲净罐子。

29.5.en: Its [[maiden:maiden]] [[trial:trial]] passed, pleasing the whole tired [[household:household]] at [[dusk:dusk]].
29.5.zh: 首次试验顺利通过，让疲惫的全家人在黄昏时分满心欢喜。

30.0.en: Each dull [[chore:chore]] felt light when the students sang, led by a funny [[host:host]].
30.0.zh: 有风趣的主持人领唱，再枯燥的杂活也变得轻快。

30.1.en: The grey-haired [[landlord:landlord]] lent a [[shed:shed]], and his new [[tenant:tenant]] swept it clean.
30.1.zh: 白发的房东借出棚屋，新来的房客把它扫得干干净净。

30.2.en: Each [[guest:guest]] tasted the clean tea, and every shop [[customer:customer]] praised the clear water.
30.2.zh: 每位客人都尝到了干净的茶，店里每位顾客都夸水清。

30.3.en: A shy [[client:client]] asked questions, and one brief [[encounter:encounter]] led to more help.
30.3.zh: 一位害羞的客户提了问题，短短一面之缘带来了更多帮助。

30.4.en: The students did not [[chase:chase]] stray dogs or [[miss:miss]] lunch while fixing the drips.
30.4.zh: 修滴水点的日子里，学生们不追野狗，也不误午饭。

30.5.en: After each [[appointment:appointment]] with the judges, Mei would [[accompany:accompany]] Lin to the gate.
30.5.zh: 每次与评委约见之后，梅都陪林走到门口。

31.0.en: Small Bo, still [[dependent:dependent]] on crutches, dared to [[propose:propose]] a safer spout.
31.0.zh: 拄着双拐还要靠人照应的小波，大胆提出了更安全的水嘴方案。

31.1.en: Their close [[engagement:engagement]] with the street felt sweet, longer than a short [[honeymoon:honeymoon]].
31.1.zh: 他们与街坊的紧密情谊甜蜜绵长，胜过短暂的蜜月。

31.2.en: No row caused [[divorce:divorce]] in the team; everyone kept a [[single:single]] shared aim.
31.2.zh: 没有争吵让团队散伙，大家守着同一个目标。

31.3.en: Mei took [[sole:sole]] care of the charts, and the others kept their [[respective:respective]] jars in line.
31.3.zh: 梅独自负责图表，其他人把各自的罐子排列整齐。

31.4.en: Each [[individual:individual]] wrote notes, even the tired [[commuter:commuter]] uncle from North Street.
31.4.zh: 人人都记笔记，连北街疲惫的通勤叔叔也写。

31.5.en: The whole [[neighbourhood:neighbourhood]] clapped, even the [[stern:stern]] [[boss:boss]] from the tea shop.
31.5.zh: 整个街坊都鼓起掌来，连茶铺里严厉的老板也在拍手。

32.0.en: A kind [[supervisor:supervisor]] praised the work, never scolding a slow [[subordinate:subordinate]] helper.
32.0.zh: 和善的主管夸赞大家的活儿，从不责骂手脚慢的下属帮手。

32.1.en: Lan chose Tao as her [[partner:partner]], too shy to [[mate:mate]] pigeons for the school show.
32.1.zh: 兰选涛做搭档，她太害羞，不好意思为校园演出配对鸽子。

32.2.en: A sick [[colleague:colleague]] sent greetings, and a brave [[comrade:comrade]] brought soup at noon.
32.2.zh: 生病的同事捎来问候，勇敢的伙伴中午送来热汤。

32.3.en: An old [[acquaintance:acquaintance]] smiled warmly, showing true [[affection:affection]] for the busy [[crew:crew]].
32.3.zh: 一位老相识暖暖地笑着，对忙碌的全组人满怀真心的喜爱。

32.4.en: A kind [[stranger:stranger]] watched for a long while, then joined as an eager [[apprentice:apprentice]] helper.
32.4.zh: 一位好心的陌生人看了许久，随后加入成了热心的学徒帮手。

32.5.en: The tired [[deputy:deputy]] head bowed to each small [[hero:hero]] of the street.
32.5.zh: 疲惫的副校长向街上每一位小英雄鞠躬。

33.0.en: Rain fell softly over the [[quiet:quiet]] roofs and washed the dusty lanes at last.
33.0.zh: 细雨轻轻落在安静的屋顶上，终于洗净了尘土飞扬的小巷。

33.1.en: A brave [[heroine:heroine]] from the [[drama:drama]] club and a shy [[actress:actress]] cheered loudly.
33.1.zh: 戏剧社里勇敢的女主角和害羞的女演员放声喝彩。

33.2.en: No [[stern:stern]] [[chancellor:chancellor]] visited, but a retired [[commander:commander]] sent a kind note.
33.2.zh: 严厉的大臣没有来访，退休的指挥官却寄来一张暖心字条。

33.3.en: The kind [[director:director]] of the fair stayed a firm [[proponent:proponent]] of school builds.
33.3.zh: 集市上和善的主任，始终是校园工程的坚定支持者。

33.4.en: The fair [[committee:committee]] met twice, and the town [[council:council]] lent chairs and tables.
33.4.zh: 集市委员会开了两次会，镇议会借出了桌椅。

33.5.en: They chose Lan as [[delegate:delegate]], guided by a water [[specialist:specialist]] from South Street.
33.5.zh: 他们推选兰做代表，还有南街的水专家从旁指导。

34.0.en: Children laughed aloud and shared warm buns with every [[guest:guest]] under the bright lamps.
34.0.zh: 明亮的灯下，孩子们大声笑着，把热包子分给每一位来宾。

34.1.en: A plant [[consultant:consultant]] and a kind [[veterinary:veterinary]] doctor praised the safe runoff.
34.1.zh: 植物顾问和和善的兽医都夸排水安全。

34.2.en: The school [[counsellor:counsellor]] smiled, and a fair [[solicitor:solicitor]] explained the [[contest:contest]] rules clearly.
34.2.zh: 学校辅导员面带微笑，公正的事务律师把比赛规则讲得清清楚楚。

34.3.en: No [[stern:stern]] [[attorney:attorney]] argued, and a calm [[umpire:umpire]] timed each [[trial:trial]] fairly.
34.3.zh: 没有严厉的律师争辩，沉稳的裁判为每次试验公平计时。

34.4.en: The busy [[cashier:cashier]] from the store and a tall [[fireman:fireman]] kept [[order:order]] near the spouts.
34.4.zh: 店里忙碌的收银员和高个子消防员在水嘴旁维持秩序。

34.5.en: A [[gentle:gentle]] [[nurse:nurse]] [[bound:bound]] an aching knuckle, while a cheerful [[gardener:gardener]] planted new seeds.
34.5.zh: 温柔的护士包扎好作痛的指关节，开朗的园丁种下新种子。

35.0.en: Morning sun dried the wet paths, and the students greeted the whole [[neighbourhood:neighbourhood]] with smiles.
35.0.zh: 晨阳晒干了湿漉漉的小路，学生们笑着向整条街坊问好。

35.1.en: The funny [[barber:barber]] promised free [[haircut:haircuts]] to the winners after the fair.
35.1.zh: 风趣的理发师许诺，集市结束后给获胜者免费理发。

35.2.en: The old [[fisherman:fisherman]] grinned widely, while the kind [[butcher:butcher]] shared hot buns.
35.2.zh: 老渔夫咧嘴大笑，和善的屠夫分发热包子。

35.3.en: Boys learned to [[groom:groom]] the ponies gently; no shouting held patience [[hostage:hostage]] any more.
35.3.zh: 男孩们学会轻柔地给小马梳毛，喊叫再也不能挟持耐心。

35.4.en: Years of hard [[toil:toil]] ended sweetly; even a poor [[beggar:beggar]] drank clean water.
35.4.zh: 多年的辛苦劳作有了甜美的收尾，连穷乞丐也喝上了清水。

35.5.en: Nobody lived as a tired [[slave:slave]] to thirst, and no [[coward:coward]] feared telling the truth.
35.5.zh: 没有人再做干渴的疲惫奴隶，也没有懦夫不敢说真话。

paraZh.24: 接缝修整灰水净化，原型立上木架，老陈教操作促检查。
paraZh.25: 沟水转化浇花坛，黄昏调阀定位滴漏，三天试验读数精准。
paraZh.26: 小错暴露裂痕被修好，老海员稳当先驱，梅兰接下衣钵。
paraZh.27: 三代同写姓氏名单，祖父搬罐，孩子看豆胚如婴儿初醒。
paraZh.28: 小狗孤儿也来帮忙，青少年扫巷，乡亲远亲夜里亲密畅谈。
paraZh.29: 小莹端茶待客，林老师夸手稳；女眷各司其职，首试通过。
paraZh.30: 主持人领唱杂活变轻，房东借棚客商夸水，梅陪林赴约。
paraZh.31: 拄拐小波提议安全水嘴，全街鼓掌，众人同守一个目标。
paraZh.32: 主管不骂下属，兰涛结伴送汤；陌生人当学徒，副手敬英雄。
paraZh.33: 雨洗小巷戏剧社喝彩，指挥官寄字条，兰当选代表获专家指导。
paraZh.34: 灯下分包子迎宾，律师讲规则裁判计时，护士包扎园丁播种。
paraZh.35: 晨阳晒干小路，理发师渔夫屠夫同庆，辛劳换来清水与勇气。
